source: Lin, H., Lasser, J., Lewandowsky, S., Cole, R., Gully, A., Rand, D. G., & Pennycook, G. (2023). High level of correspondence across different news domain quality rating sets. PNAS Nexus, 2(9), pgad286. https://doi.org/10.1093/pnasnexus/pgad286
terms: The authors invite reuse ("Feel free to reuse the data"); no formal licence file is published, so the dataset is credited by citation.
scale: pc1: first principal component of six professional rating sets after imputation, normalised to 0 (lowest quality) - 1 (highest quality).

mapping.description: Converts pc1 to this project's 0-10 reliability scale by least squares over the outlets rated in both data/sourceReputation.json and this set. Used only for domains the curated list does not cover; the curated list is consulted first.
